use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant across subsidiaries (drafting, summarizing, search over files the user can open)
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite provider's enterprise assistant (large language model)
data_categories: Whatever the user can open in the productivity suite: email, chat, files, meetings; includes Restricted data (Finance customer information, payroll data, plan PHI, MNPI)
consequential_decision_category: None (prohibited in decisions about people by POL-05 4.6)
human_in_the_loop: User reviews every output; no agent actions; no connectors to business systems
applicable_laws: FTC Safeguards Rule (16 CFR 314.4(c)(1)(ii), (f)); HIPAA plan sponsor limits (45 CFR 164.504(f)(2)(iii)); Regulation FD and insider trading policy; recording consent laws for meeting transcripts (all-party consent applied; Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example); FTC Act Section 5
status: In production (about 4,000 users; expansion paused for Finance, HR, and deal sites)
bias_testing_status: Not used in decisions; usage review for HR misuse (section 7.4)
monitoring: Monthly cross-entity access test; quarterly output quality sample; usage logs reviewed for prohibited uses

use_case: Credit underwriting model producing approve, decline, or refer decisions and pricing tiers for dealer applications
data_categories: Application data; consumer reports; dealer and equipment data
human_in_the_loop: Underwriters review all refer decisions and a 5% sample of automated declines; adverse action reasons generated from model features and reviewed quarterly
applicable_laws: ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.4(a), 1002.5(b), 1002.6(b), 1002.9(b)(2)); FTC Safeguards Rule; state lending laws
monitoring: Monthly approval-rate and score drift; quarterly reason-code accuracy sample

use_case: Collections prioritization model ranking delinquent accounts for outreach
human_in_the_loop: Collectors choose actions; no automated adverse action
applicable_laws: ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.4(a)); FTC Act Section 5
bias_testing_status: Outreach rates by segment reviewed quarterly

use_case: Application fraud detection flagging dealer-submitted applications for manual review
data_categories: Application data; device and dealer signals
human_in_the_loop: Every flagged application is reviewed by a fraud analyst; no automated declines
applicable_laws: ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.4(a), 1002.9); FTC Safeguards Rule
bias_testing_status: Vendor-supplied testing only; local flag-rate review planned (section 6)
monitoring: Monthly flag rate and false-positive rate by dealer segment

use_case: Resume screening and ranking feature in the applicant tracking system
applicable_laws: Title VII (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2); Uniform Guidelines adverse impact measure (29 CFR 1607.4(D)); ADEA
bias_testing_status: None; adverse impact analysis required before any re-enable
